name: Images
description: Resize, convert, and edit images in your browser.

image-resize.name: Image Resizer
image-resize.description: Resize an image and convert it to PNG, JPEG, or WebP — entirely on your device.

image-crop.name: Image Crop
image-crop.description: Crop an image with aspect presets and a live preview — on your device.

image-rotate.name: Rotate & Flip
image-rotate.description: Rotate an image in quarter turns or mirror it horizontally and vertically — on your device.

image-compress.name: Image Compressor
image-compress.description: Shrink an image's file size with a live before/after comparison — on your device.

tips.1: WebP usually lands 25–35% smaller than JPEG at the same visual quality.
tips.2: Quality 70–85 is the sweet spot for photos on the web.
tips.3: For screenshots with text, PNG via the Resizer often beats lossy formats.

image-filters.name: Image Filters
image-filters.description: Apply grayscale, blur, or sharpen with a live preview — on your device.

image-colors.name: Color Picker
image-colors.description: Pick any pixel's color and extract an image's dominant palette — on your device.

exif-remove.name: EXIF Remover
exif-remove.description: Strip location, camera, and editing metadata from a photo before sharing it — on your device.

aspect-ratio.name: Aspect Ratio
aspect-ratio.description: Simplify a resolution to its ratio and solve the missing side when scaling.

image-watermark.name: Watermark
image-watermark.description: Stamp text onto an image with position, size, and opacity control — on your device.

image-compare.name: Image Compare
image-compare.description: Overlay two images with a slider divider to spot the differences — on your device.

image-metadata.name: Metadata Viewer
image-metadata.description: See an image's dimensions, format, and JPEG EXIF details — including whether location data is embedded.

image-batch.name: Batch Processor
image-batch.description: Resize, convert, and compress many images at once, then download them all as one ZIP — on your device.

favicon-generate.name: Favicon Generator
favicon-generate.description: Turn one image into the full favicon set (16–512px) plus a ready HTML snippet — zipped.

ui.dropTitle: Drop an image here, or click to choose
ui.dropReplace: Drop a new image to replace the current one
ui.dropHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, and anything else your browser can open.
ui.privacy: Your image never leaves this device — everything happens in your browser.
ui.errorUnsupported: Couldn't open that file as an image. Try a PNG, JPEG, or WebP.
ui.errorDimensions: Width and height must be whole numbers between 1 and 20,000 pixels.
ui.errorExport: Export failed — this browser may not support encoding to the selected format.
ui.pickAlt: Loaded image — click to sample a color
ui.pickHint: Click anywhere on the image to sample that pixel's color.
ui.exifHow: The image is redrawn from its pixels, so the saved copy carries no metadata at all — no location, camera model, timestamps, or editing history.
ui.ratioInvalid: Enter a width and height greater than zero.
ui.metaGpsWarning: This photo embeds GPS coordinates. Use the EXIF Remover before sharing it if that matters.
ui.metaNoExif: No EXIF metadata found — PNGs and WebP images usually carry none, and that's a good thing for privacy.
ui.batchDropTitle: Drop images here — as many as you like
ui.batchDropMore: Drop more images, or click to add
ui.batchDropHint: One set of rules, applied to every image. Nothing is uploaded.
ui.batchRun: Process {count, plural, one {# image} other {# images}}
ui.batchPrivacy: Every image is processed in your browser — re-encoding also strips all metadata.
ui.faviconExplain: The image is center-cropped to a square and rendered at 16, 32, 48, 180, 192, and 512 pixels, with a ready-to-paste HTML snippet included.
ui.batchFolderHint: Folders keep their structure — drop them straight onto the zone too.
ui.batchTemplateHint: {name} = original name, {index} = position. Dimensions and format are appended automatically.
